summary: AGM Group Holdings Inc., a Hong Kong-based technology company listed on Nasdaq, filed a Form 6-K reporting that it received a Nasdaq letter confirming compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) after filing its overdue Form 20-F for FY2025 on August 7, 2026. The May 18, 2026 non-compliance notice was resolved, and Nasdaq closed the matter. This is a routine regulatory compliance update, not a special situation. No transaction, strategic action, or material corporate event is involved. Watch-list: no further action required; the company regained listing compliance.
